content.text: Mangalore is the hub for medical science courses. Here, many allied health science courses are also available. sections.heading: BSc Anesthesia and OT Technology Eligibility Criteria in Mangalore

content.text: As the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test is not mandatory to apply to Allied Health Science courses, students can easily apply directly to BSc Anesthesia and OT Technology. The following are some of the BSc Anesthesia and OT Technology eligibility in Mangalore –

items: Candidates must complete their 10+2 exam from a recognized both.
They must have subjects PCB – Physics, Chemistry and Biology in their 12th curriculum.
Students must achieve a minimum aggregate mark as per university norms (usually 45 to 50%)
All the students must be 17 years or above at the time of admission.

content.text: All colleges of Mangalore are under the affiliation of RGUHS – Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences , and they regulate this admission process. This whole BSc Anesthesia and OT Technology Admission in Mangalore process is given below in several steps for an easy walkthrough.

items: Step 1: Look for a suitable college, as per your ROI.
Step 2: Go through their official website or visit their college’s office to submit the application form.
Step 3: Upon confirmation, pay the required fees, which are given in the fee structure of that college’s prospectus.
Step 4: Finally, finish the process of Document Verification by bringing all the supporting documents that are required for this step.
Step 5: Lastly, receive the admission confirmation mail that finalizes this BSc Anesthesia and OT Technology Admission Process in Mangalore.

content.text: Remember, there are limited seats in the colleges of Mangalore for this program. So, hurry and apply to secure your spot.
